charge_description: Summary conviction of Elizabeth Craven of Whitby grocer for having in her possession two one-pound weights which were both short by three drams, one eight-ounce weight which was short by two drams, another eight-ounce weight which was short by three drams, and a small brass weight which was also deficient
sentencing: Offence committed at Whitby on 24 December 1808
